entity: Illinois state hazardous-waste inspectors' 15.5% violation write-up rate at sites where EPA found violations
why: EPA OIG (2026-04-28) reports the same kind of finding in general - EPA-led inspections find violations 76% vs states' 52% - without naming Illinois's same-site rate. Investigate Midwest covers Illinois's enforcement decline, a different measure. Nothing states our state-by-state gap.
